rules.rule: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules or icons.
Grounds and panels are Bone cream, Warm near-black or Oxblood and nothing else.
On Warm near-black or Oxblood, all type is Bone cream.
Type set directly on a photograph is Bone cream or Warm near-black.
On Bone cream, the wordmark, headings, body, specification, fine print and timing line are Warm near-black; small captions and footer lines may be Tempered steel, a small label Oxblood.
Aged brass is for hairline rules and dividers only.
Tempered steel is for small captions, footer lines, labels and dividers only.
Every palette colour is solid at 100% opacity; no tint, gradient, shadow, metallic, foil, glow or blend effect.
No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour is laid over a photograph.
Apart from the campaign treatment, photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette (Vesper deep blue dial, Ardent oxblood dial and strap).
Voice: exact, understated, collector to collector (no hype).
One committed warm single-tone treatment across the campaign, warm not blue.

rules.rule: Display / H1: Cormorant Garamond Medium capitals, tracked 180 (key visual wordmark 72 px; dealer heading 28 pt).
Subheading / H2 and any other Cormorant line: reference names, subheads and headlines in Cormorant Garamond Medium capitals, tracked 180.
Body: Inter Regular (supporting copy).
Body: specification text in Inter Regular (digital 22 px; dealer 10 pt).
Fine print: prices, serials, timing results and captions in Inter Regular, tabular lining.
Visible type-scale relationships: wordmark over reference name over specification.
Newly typeset wordmarks are stacked as Lunara over Chronometry, never on one line.
Signature move: no figure is set in the serif; every numeral switches to Inter at the surrounding size.
All numerals use tabular lining figures (tabular spacing is judged where figures stand in a column).
Timing text uses Inter Regular, never italic.
At most 65 characters per line of body text.
Use the attached Cormorant Garamond and Inter; do not substitute another family.
Leave lettering inside watch photographs unchanged.
Keep the watch's reference, case geometry, dial appearance and finish accurate.
Product features and dealer information use the exact register wording.
Do not invent product features absent from the approved inputs.
Do not invent prices; the only approved price is the band in lunara_notes.txt.
The timing line in lunara_notes.txt is fixed and is not reworded.
Use the supplied watch photographs (campaign frame for the key visual, matching PDP frame per watch).
Any movement description matches the caliber descriptions in lunara_notes.txt.
Each reference carries its own caliber (register rows 2 to 6; LC-25-0114 and Selene LM-03 rows are traps).
Knockouts of the bracelet references leave no sweep in enclosed link gaps; the Meridian polished flank is kept whole.
